'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**Thirty-five [[Islamic State – West Africa Province|Islamic State]] members are killed during a fight with [[Boko Haram]] militants in [[Lake Chad]], resulting in the dislodgement of Islamic State from two of its enclaves. [https://punchng.com/boko-haram-kills-35-iswap-combatants-in-lake-chad/ (Punch)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Five people are killed and 23 others are injured in a bus crash in [[Diyarbakır]], [[Turkey]]. [https://armenpress.am/eng/news/1101192/ (Armenpress)]
*Five people are killed and ten others are missing after [[list of migrant vessel incidents on the Mediterranean Sea|a boat carrying migrants sinks]] off the coast of [[Tunisia]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/1/7/five-die-10-missing-after-boat-sinks-off-tunisia (Al Jazeera)]
* [[2023 Mexico City Metro train crash]]
**One person is killed and 57 others are injured when two trains crash on [[Mexico City Metro Line 3|Line 3]] of the [[Mexico City Metro]] in [[Mexico City]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jan/07/at-least-one-dead-and-22-injured-in-collision-on-mexico-citys-metro (''The Guardian'')] [https://www.excelsior.com.mx/comunidad/metro-cdmx-hoy-7-de-enero-reportan-incidente-en-l3-y-desalojan-a-usuarios/1562884 (''Excélsior'' in Spanish)]
*Two people are killed and another person is injured when a roof collapses in [[Alexandria]], [[Egypt]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/egypts-state-media-says-roof-collapse-in-alexandria-kills-2/2023/01/07/3beeba7a-8e78-11ed-b86a-2e3a77336b8e_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]
*Twenty-one people are killed and 49 others are injured when a bus heading for [[Nairobi]], [[Kenya]], crashes after crossing the border from [[Uganda]]. [https://www.barrons.com/articles/21-die-in-bus-crash-on-kenya-uganda-border-01673176809 (AFP via ''Barron's'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*One person is killed and 60 others are injured in a [[prison riot]] in [[Pathein]], [[Myanmar]]. [https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/prisoner-killed-dozens-wounded-in-myanmar-jail-riot-101673080944871.html (AFP via ''Hindustan Times'')]
*[[South Sudan]]ese authorities arrest six journalists from [[South Sudan Broadcasting Corporation|the country's public broadcaster]] on suspicion of distributing unauthorized footage of [[President of South Sudan|President]] [[Salva Kiir Mayardit]] that [[Viral video|went viral]] internationally in December. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2023-01-08/south-sudan-president-salva-kiir-arrests/101835404 (AP via ABC News Australia)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[January 2023 Speaker of the United States House of Representatives election|2023 Speaker of the United States House of Representatives election]]
**[[Kevin McCarthy]] is elected [[speaker of the United States House of Representatives]] after fifteen rounds of voting, the most rounds since 1860. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-64193932 (BBC News)]
